title: At the train ticket machine
instructions: Bir turist bilet makinesini kullanamıyor ve yardım istiyor. Kısa bir diyalog; fiyata dikkat et.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Excuse me, can you help me? The machine won't take my card.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Some machines only take cash. Try the one by the door.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Thanks. Do you know how much a ticket to the airport is?

script.speaker: b
script.text: It's about twelve pounds. The train goes every twenty minutes.
